svg.title: Mallow — Local AI Application system design
svg.desc: Architecture diagram showing users, web and desktop clients, Next.js, FastAPI, LangGraph agents, local model and data services, meeting audio processing, optional external integrations, operator-only MCP tools, and observability.
svg.text: System design · local-first AI workspace · current web and macOS source-checkout workflows

g.text: HTTP rewrites to FastAPI; WS direct
Chat · document · RAG · SQL · web research
Responses and events stream back to the client
PDF · Office · CSV · HTML · Markdown · images
Parsed text + metadata → file store / RAG
Bounded PCM queue → local faster-whisper ASR
Conversation recall · action items · tool records
Metal on native macOS; CPU in Docker
Read-only workspace mount for code agent
Configured / registered by operator or account
Separate from the app’s SQLite database
Only this path needs public internet

svg.text: Not the same path as user chat agents

g.text: 1 Browser request → frontend → authenticated API 2 Request → agent/profile → local model, tools or data 3 Parsed content → embeddings + BM25 → Qdrant → cited response
Docker ports bind to loopback. Docker Ollama is CPU-only; native Ollama is recommended on Apple Silicon.
